description: This file defines an asynchronous helper function 'withTempDir' that creates a temporary directory, executes a callback with the directory path, and cleans up afterward. It involves file system operations such as creating and removing directories, and handles optional subdirectory creation.

methods.name: export async function withTempDir<T>( withTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory, runs the passed async callback with the directory path, and removes the directory after completion.

ctags.name: base
ctags.pattern: /^  const base = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(options.parentDir ?? os.tmpdir(), options.prefix));$/

ctags.name: dir
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/
